overview: The period is dominated by simulation-based inference and generative surrogates: normalizing flows for DESI DR1 tomographic N(z), SBi3PCF with DES Y3 cosmic shear, and latent corrections to field-level weak-lensing generators. Neural operators and PINNs emulate MHD turbulence, rotating stars and solar-wind boundaries. LLM agents calibrate simulations, allocate observing time, and extract literature-scale catalogues. New benchmarks include COSMIO, the FAIR Universe weak-lensing challenge and small-data image classifiers; gravitational-wave papers contribute waveform generators and early-warning classifiers.
